scenes.prompt: Extreme close-up of a warm, gentle anime-style face, honey-colored eyes crinkling in a friendly smile, soft golden lighting illuminating dust motes, nostalgic and comforting atmosphere, high-detail cinematic art.

A desolate, cold-toned scene of an anime character standing alone in the rain, subtle shadows of puppet strings descending from the sky, a cracked porcelain mask lying shattered at their feet, emotional despair.

A wide-eyed anime character in a dark, high-contrast room, one side of their face illuminated by a harsh white light, a look of sudden, chilling realization, trembling hands held to their chest, psychological thriller aesthetic.

An intricate still life of a steaming cup of tea and an open book on a sunlit table, but the reflection in the window shows a distorted, jagged silhouette reaching out, contrast between domestic peace and hidden malice.

A tender embrace between two anime figures in a library, the one hugging has a sharp, calculating glint in their eye while maintaining a soft, fake smile, warm candlelight, depth of field focusing on the deceptive gaze.
scenes.text: it looks kind, caring, and intelligent.
